title: 整数减法应用题
summary: 用总路程减去已走路程求剩余距离
scene_svg:
<g id="subtraction-scene">
  <defs>
    <filter id="inkShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="2" dy="3" stdDeviation="2" flood-color="#1f2937" flood-opacity="0.25"/>
    </filter>
    <linearGradient id="roadGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#e7e5e4"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d6d3d1"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="vermilionGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fee2e2"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#fecaca"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <style>
    .dashed-line { stroke-dasharray: 8,6; fill:none; stroke-linecap:round; }
    @keyframes floatY { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-8px); } }
    @keyframes pulseNum { 0%,100% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.12); } }
    @keyframes dashFlow { 0% { stroke-dashoffset: 28; } 100% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }
    .float-anim { animation: floatY 2.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .pulse-anim { animation: pulseNum 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; transform-origin: center; }
    .flow-anim { animation: dashFlow 1s linear infinite; }
    .math-text { font-family: "Kaiti","STKaiti","楷体",serif; }
    .label-text { font-family: "Kaiti","STKaiti","楷体",serif; }
  </style>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 1" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-700 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 scale-90" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 scale-100">
    <text x="120" y="310" font-size="48" text-anchor="middle" class="float-anim">🏠</text>
    <text x="120" y="345" class="label-text" font-size="20" fill="#1f2937" text-anchor="middle">家</text>
    <text x="580" y="310" font-size="48" text-anchor="middle" class="float-anim">🏫</text>
    <text x="580" y="345" class="label-text" font-size="20" fill="#1f2937" text-anchor="middle">学校</text>
    <rect x="235" y="255" width="230" height="36" rx="18" fill="#fdfbf7" stroke="#78716c" stroke-width="1.5" filter="url(#inkShadow)"/>
    <text x="350" y="280" class="math-text" font-size="22" fill="#1f2937" text-anchor="middle">全程 800 米</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 2" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-1000 ease-in-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 scale-x-0" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 scale-x-100" style="transform-origin: 150px 390px;">
    <rect x="150" y="375" width="400" height="30" rx="15" fill="url(#roadGradient)" stroke="#78716c" stroke-width="1.5" filter="url(#inkShadow)"/>
    <line x1="150" y1="415" x2="150" y2="435" stroke="#44403c" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="550" y1="415" x2="550" y2="435" stroke="#44403c" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="150" y="455" class="label-text" font-size="18" fill="#44403c" text-anchor="middle">0 米</text>
    <text x="550" y="455" class="label-text" font-size="18" fill="#44403c" text-anchor="middle">800 米</text>
  </g>

  <rect x-show="sceneStep >= 3" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-700 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100" :opacity="sceneStep >= 9 ? 0.35 : 0.9" x="150" y="375" width="175" height="30" rx="15" fill="url(#vermilionGradient)" stroke="#8a1c1c" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <path x-show="sceneStep >= 3" class="dashed-line flow-anim" :opacity="sceneStep >= 9 ? 0.4 : 1" d="M 150 360 Q 237 330 325 360" stroke="#8a1c1c" stroke-width="3"/>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 3" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-700 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 translate-y-4" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0">
    <rect x="245" y="315" width="90" height="32" rx="16" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#8a1c1c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="290" y="338" class="math-text" font-size="20" :fill="sceneStep >= 9 ? '#78716c' : '#8a1c1c'" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">350 米</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 4" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-1000 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 -translate-x-12" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-x-0">
    <text x="325" y="360" font-size="44" text-anchor="middle" class="float-anim">🚶</text>
    <text x="325" y="470" class="label-text" font-size="18" fill="#1f2937" text-anchor="middle">小明休息处</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 5" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-700 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 -translate-y-4" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0">
    <rect :fill="sceneStep >= 7 && sceneStep <= 8 ? '#fff7ed' : '#fdfbf7'" x="280" y="80" width="240" height="180" rx="12" stroke="#78716c" stroke-width="1.5" filter="url(#inkShadow)"/>

    <g x-show="sceneStep >= 7" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-500 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100">
      <text x="330" y="105" class="math-text" font-size="18" fill="#8a1c1c" text-anchor="middle">7</text>
      <text x="350" y="105" class="math-text" font-size="18" fill="#8a1c1c" text-anchor="middle">10</text>
    </g>

    <text x="330" y="130" class="math-text" font-size="32" fill="#1f2937" text-anchor="middle">8</text>
    <text x="350" y="130" class="math-text" font-size="32" fill="#1f2937" text-anchor="middle">0</text>
    <text x="370" y="130" class="math-text" font-size="32" fill="#1f2937" text-anchor="middle">0</text>

    <text x="310" y="160" class="math-text" font-size="28" fill="#1f2937" text-anchor="middle">−</text>
    <text x="330" y="160" class="math-text" font-size="32" fill="#1f2937" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
    <text x="350" y="160" class="math-text" font-size="32" fill="#1f2937" text-anchor="middle">5</text>
    <text x="370" y="160" class="math-text" font-size="32" fill="#1f2937" text-anchor="middle">0</text>

    <line x1="300" y1="170" x2="390" y2="170" stroke="#1f2937" stroke-width="2"/>

    <g x-show="sceneStep >= 9" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-700 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 scale-90" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 scale-100">
      <text x="330" y="200" class="math-text pulse-anim" font-size="32" fill="#16a34a" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">4</text>
      <text x="350" y="200" class="math-text pulse-anim" font-size="32" fill="#16a34a" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">5</text>
      <text x="370" y="200" class="math-text pulse-anim" font-size="32" fill="#16a34a" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">0</text>
    </g>

    <g x-show="sceneStep === 6" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-500 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100">
      <rect x="300" y="215" width="100" height="26" rx="13" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#8a1c1c" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="350" y="233" class="math-text" font-size="15" fill="#8a1c1c" text-anchor="middle">个位 0 − 0 = 0</text>
    </g>

    <g x-show="sceneStep === 7" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-500 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100">
      <rect x="265" y="215" width="170" height="26" rx="13" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#8a1c1c" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="350" y="233" class="math-text" font-size="15" fill="#8a1c1c" text-anchor="middle">十位 0 不够减 5，向百位借 1</text>
    </g>

    <g x-show="sceneStep === 8" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-500 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100">
      <rect x="300" y="215" width="100" height="26" rx="13" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#8a1c1c" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="350" y="233" class="math-text" font-size="15" fill="#8a1c1c" text-anchor="middle">百位 7 − 3 = 4</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <rect x-show="sceneStep >= 9" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-700 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100" x="325" y="375" width="225" height="30" rx="15" fill="#dcfce7" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.9"/>

  <path x-show="sceneStep >= 9" class="dashed-line flow-anim" d="M 325 360 Q 437 330 550 360" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="3"/>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 9" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-700 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 scale-90" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 scale-100">
    <rect x="430" y="315" width="90" height="32" rx="16" fill="#dcfce7" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="475" y="338" class="math-text pulse-anim" font-size="22" fill="#16a34a" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">450 米</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 10" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-1000 ease-out" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 scale-90" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 scale-100">
    <rect x="260" y="500" width="280" height="60" rx="12" fill="#fef9c3" stroke="#ca8a04" stroke-width="1.5" filter="url(#inkShadow)"/>
    <text x="400" y="540" class="math-text" font-size="22" fill="#1f2937" text-anchor="middle">验算：350 + 450 = 800 ✓</text>
  </g>
</g>
